amendment_A1_zero_cost_readouts.reason: paid census impossible (key exhausted); the plan's intent (ONE readout for both models in every contrast) is approximated at $0

readouts.P1_real: real gemini P1 labels: exp1 native (10,852) + exact (normalised request, identical response) propagation to other artifacts
readouts.P1_sur: TF-IDF+LR surrogate trained ONLY on real P1 labels (exp1), applied to every response of both models
readouts.pooled_P1: binary LR on TF-IDF + judge-prompt one-hot, trained on ALL real LLM-judge labels (P1, EXP2, SYS_REF, JP2), predicted with the P1 indicator
readouts.native: each artifact's own judge prompt (only where both models are labelled)

amendment_A1_zero_cost_readouts.cell_gate: a cell is readout-valid if >=95% of its rows carry real P1 labels, OR the pooled surrogate's out-of-fold prediction vs that cell's real judge labels passes the M2 gate (kappa>=0.6, or PABAK>=0.80 and prevalence index>0.7); cells with no real labels of any prompt are UNVALIDATED
amendment_A1_zero_cost_readouts.statistic_status: a statistic is CITABLE only if every input cell is readout-valid; else PROVISIONAL (reported, not citable)

rules.MAIN: C1 pass AND 90% CI of D within +/-m AND 90% CI of overall DiD within +/-m (exp1) AND |G3|<m (exp4 C3 conjunct)
rules.ALT-1: D > m with 95% CI excluding 0 (or C3: G3 > m with CI > 0)
rules.ALT-3_persona_exp3: exp3 verdict(): TD* conditions; UNTESTABLE when the manipulation check failed (iter-1: failed in GaMS)
rules.ALT-4: Sig_EN > m2 and Sig_SL > m2, both CIs > 0, |Sig_SL - Sig_EN| < m
rules.C1: DiD_id > m_id with 95% CI lower bound > 0
rules.INCONCLUSIVE: any rule not satisfied while MDE = 2.8 SE > 2m

bootstrap.unit: item cluster (pair / EN-prompt sha1); C3 pair x trial

meta_analysis.E5_note: exp3 slmt cells saved only prefix scores s, no responses -> not judgeable -> excluded
meta_analysis.pooling: GLS on joint cluster-bootstrap covariance (primary); REML + modified HKSJ (independence, reference); Q, I2 with Q-profile CI, 95% PI, leave-one-out

amendment_A2_informativeness_guard.timing: after reading the pooled surrogate's out-of-fold validation, BEFORE any M4/M5/M6 statistic was computed
amendment_A2_informativeness_guard.rule: for SURROGATE-based cells the M2 gate additionally requires kappa >= 0.4 whenever the cell has >= 10 minority-class items
amendment_A2_informativeness_guard.reason: at 85-99% refusal prevalence the PABAK/prevalence clause is passed by a near-constant 'always refuse' predictor (e.g. exp4 gemma prefill10 EN: kappa 0.00, PABAK .92); the clause was designed to protect a real judge from the kappa paradox, not to certify an uninformative surrogate. Stricter than A1, so it can only remove citability.
